sources.games: 1943 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 47.1%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py rubick.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 86 (abilities named in fight and skills), 7.41f.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-11-07 (support wave): the build follows the STRATZ high-rank order where it and the league games disagree; Eul's Scepter answers Phantom Strike and Charge of Darkness (Jakiro, Rubick, Skywrath Mage, Tusk); Rod of Atos against escapes (a root stops walking and blink escapes); Ghost Scepter against two physical carries stays on thin samples; the skill builds and talents are the most common ones.

rules.name: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Eul's Scepter of Divinity: Cyclone on an enemy or on yourself (never an ally), 2.5 s of invulnerability, 23 s cooldown, 175 mana; cast on yourself it goes through spell immunity. Whether a jump cast on a cycloned hero is lost is not in the datafeed (asked). High-rank games against heroes that jump onto a target: 28% of 122 games (12% otherwise), won 59% with it against 43% without; STRATZ pos4 has it at 27 min (25%, won 58%).

reason.en: {enemy} jumps onto a chosen target: {item} makes you invulnerable for 2.5 s or lifts the jumper out of the fight
reason.uk: {enemy} стрибає на обрану ціль: {item} робить вас невразливим на 2,5 с або підхоплює стрибуна й забирає його з бійки

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute (parts and consumables dropped): arcane_boots 74% (12), essence_distiller 36% (15), blink 79% (24), glimmer_cape 26% (25), aether_lens 35% (25), force_staff 26% (26), aghanims_shard 50% (27). STRATZ pos4 (16929 games): Essence Distiller 14, Aether Lens 21, Blink Dagger 21 (100%), Glimmer Cape 24, Eul's 27 (25%), Aghanim's Scepter 34 min (42%); the league build has Force Staff where STRATZ has Eul's. Ordered by the STRATZ high-rank pos4 minute where STRATZ lists the item (16929 games), else the league minute (the player review of 2026-11-07: the STRATZ order where the two disagree).

skills.basis: 1943 games since 7.41: maxed rubick_fade_bolt > rubick_arcane_supremacy > rubick_telekinesis 1511 (win 54.6%), rubick_fade_bolt > rubick_arcane_supremacy 314 (win 17.5%), rubick_fade_bolt 43 (win 0.0%); talents 10: +200 Health 1606/1896 (48.1%), Telekinesis Cooldown 290/1896 (48.3%); 15: Fade Bolt Cooldown 699/1352 (55.1%), Stolen Spells Mana Cost 653/1352 (59.7%); 20: Fade Bolt Damage Reduction 267/503 (68.5%), Telekinesis Landing Deals Damage 236/503 (65.7%); 25: Spell Amp For Stolen Spells 51/91 (76.5%), Curiosity Bonuses 40/91 (52.5%).
